Separate branches describe Escante’s betrayal after Clifford’s removal, betrayal when Clifford proves strong, or pressure from Escante, Clifford and a Swede. Maria condemns piracy; Maldonado invokes dispossessed New World inhabitants and people of mixed ancestry, admits mutual exploitation and profit motives, and proposes fighting Escante together. The tentative acceptance and refusal branches differ. Preserve political nuance and Maria’s conditional trust without making him a selfless liberator or adding ethnic parentage.
